sign_convention: curve_ft and offline_ft: negative = left, positive = right (right-handed golfer view). curve = how much the ball bent in the air; offline = where it finished relative to the target line. launch_dir_deg: positive = right of the target. shot_type uses Rapsodo’s codes: D = draw, F = fade, RF = right-fade, R = right (push).
